Maya (CS): Quick sync for Shorehaven private deploy: status on VPC peering, IAM role scope, KMS access, and audit log ingestion?
Alejandro (NetEng): VPC peering done, route tables propagated. Waiting on Shorehaven firewall to allow inbound health-checks from 10.11.12.34/32.
Jenn (Sec): IAM: they returned a wide role. Asked them to narrow to audit-bucket S3:GetObject,S3:PutObject and CloudTrail:LookupEvents. Waiting on approval.
Samir (Observability): Audit ingest failing: our SIEM forwarder gets 403 from S3. Likely bucket policy or wrong ExternalId on role. Repro command: `aws s3 cp s3://shorehaven-audit/test.log ./ --profile shorehaven` -> 403.
Alejandro (NetEng): Shared minimal trust policy for them to paste.
Alejandro (NetEng): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-agent"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"shorehaven-987"}}}]}
```
Jenn (Sec): Also suggested S3 bucket policy snippet to allow redwood role ARN and to require aws:SourceIp for the NAT egress IP.
infra-bot: Terraform apply completed by alejandro@redwood. 5 resources added.
Maya (CS): Two blockers: firewall whitelist delay and security lead hasn't accepted scoped IAM role. Note: Shorehaven evaluation credits end in 12 days; renewal risk increases if cutover delayed >7 days.
Jenn (Sec): Recommend 30m enablement with their Sec+Infra. Propose Thu 10am PT. I'll prepare least-priv policy examples.
Alejandro (NetEng): I'll bring network diag and NAT/route diffs.
Samir (Observability): I'll prepare SIEM-forward checklist and the 403 test case.
shorehaven-ops: "Adding firewall rule now, will confirm in 15m."
Maya (CS): Actions: Maya schedule Thu10am enablement; Alejandro prep trust policy+net diag (Wed EOD); Jenn draft role + bucket policy (Wed EOD); Samir SIEM checklist + 403 repro (Wed EOD); Shorehaven whitelist 10.11.12.34/32 and accept role change.
Maya (CS): If whitelist lands, Samir will rerun ingest and update thread. If enablement slips, I'll notify AM to flag renewal risk. :thumbsup:
